summary: Aermotor LS-60 lookout near Elva, Letcher County, KY; state and federal build nearly finished by July 1931; registered on NHLR in 2026; no condition or access source found.

facts.status_note: NHLR 2026 entry is a registry listing with no condition report; no dated source on the tower's condition after 1944 found
facts.agency: Pine Mountain Trail Conference (administrator per NHLR); erected by the state forestry department with the national government in 1931, nearing completion per the July 1931 newspaper

staffing.status: 1944 notice said a forest keeper would be named; no confirmation of staffing found

events.note: July 22, 1931 Lexington Herald-Leader item, datelined Whitesburg, quoted on Forest Lookouts: tower being erected by the state forestry department with the national government, rapidly nearing completion; completion not confirmed

March 3, 1944 Middlesboro Daily News item, quoted on Forest Lookouts: association announced it would name a forest keeper for a Pine Mountain lookout station; the notice does not name Elva, so linking it to this tower is an assumption, and hiring is not confirmed

evidence.quote: This is an Aermotor LS-60 tower.

evidence.supports: administered by Pine Mountain Trail Conference
July 1931 tower being erected by state forestry department with national government, nearing completion
evidence.quote: The lookout tower being erected by the state forestry department in conjunction with the National government on a high point in the Cumberland mountains out near this city is rapidly nearing completion

evidence.supports: telephone links planned for reporting fires
evidence.quote: The station will be maintained with telephone connections so that instant communication can be given in the event of a fire outbreak.

evidence.supports: 1944 notice that a forest keeper would be named for a lookout station on Pine Mountain
evidence.quote: The Association will name a forest keeper to watch for fires from a lookout station on Pine Mountain who can report any sign of fires to state foresters.

evidence.supports: Elva placement, from the Forest Lookouts page heading

sources.title: Pine Mountain (Elva)
sources.publisher: Forest Lookouts (easternuslookouts.weebly.com), quoting the Lexington Herald-Leader (1931) and the Middlesboro Daily News (1944)

notes_for_editor: Status is unconfirmed: the NHLR 2026 entry gives no condition, and no source after 1944 was found. The July 1931 item is datelined Whitesburg, Ky. and places the tower near that city; Elva comes from the Forest Lookouts heading. Access and visit left out because no source covers them. Elva and Letcher County placement comes from the Forest Lookouts page; the 1944 notice says only 'a lookout station on Pine Mountain', so it may refer to another Pine Mountain tower. Record elevation_m 910.4 matches NHLR 2,987 ft. Two searches for Elva or Letcher County tower history found nothing confirming the site; the Birch Knob tower in Virginia and the Putney tower in Harlan County are different structures.
